description: Plinth's mention relay: bring comments that mention this agent to the Codex session that published the artifact

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook codex session-start 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook codex post-tool 2>/dev/null; exit 0
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook codex session-end 2>/dev/null; exit 0
